description_target.target_text: Infer the depth-to-color mapping from the first two panels, apply that same mapping to the third panel, and mark the candidate that matches the resulting layer-colored shape.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Panels split by maroon(9) columns. Panels 1+2 are a PLAIN/COLORED
 ;; pair teaching an onion palette: peel each shape into boundary
 ;; layers and read the majority color per depth. Recolor panel 3 by
 ;; that palette (the EXPECTED answer) and emit one row marking which
 ;; of the remaining candidate panels equals it (8 = match).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (keep-cell? v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 9))))
     (define (comp-masks grid)  ;; one 0/1 mask per shape, left-to-right
       (map (lambda (obj)
              (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows grid) (cols grid) 0)
                           (obj-cells obj) 1))
            (sort (objects (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid)
                                         (lambda (r c)
                                           (if (keep-cell?
                                                (at grid r c))
                                               1 0)))
                           0)
                  (lambda (a b)
                    (let ((ac (obj-cells a)) (bc (obj-cells b)))
                      (if (= (min-of second ac) (min-of second bc))
                          (< (min-of first ac) (min-of first bc))
                          (< (min-of second ac)
                             (min-of second bc))))))))
     (define (peel layers cur depth)  ;; onion: boundary ring = depth
       (if (empty? cur)
           layers
           (let ((boundary
                  (filter (lambda (p)
                            (any? (lambda (d)
                                    (not (member? (list (+ (first p)
                                                           (first d))
                                                        (+ (second p)
                                                           (second d)))
                                                  cur)))
                                  cardinal-deltas))
                          cur)))
             (peel (paint-cells layers boundary depth)
                   (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p boundary)))
                           cur)
                   (+ depth 1)))))
     (define (onion grid)
       (for/fold ((layers (empty-grid (rows grid) (cols grid) 0)))
                 ((comp (in-list (comp-masks grid))))
         (peel layers
               (filter (lambda (p) (> (at comp (first p) (second p))
                                      0))
                       (grid-positions comp))
               1)))
     (define (panels-of grid)  ;; split at full maroon columns
       (let scan ((c 0) (start 0) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((= c (cols grid))
                (if (> c start)
                    (append acc (list (subgrid grid 0 start
                                               (- (rows grid) 1)
                                               (- c 1))))
                    acc))
               ((all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) 9))
                      (range 0 (rows grid)))
                (scan (+ c 1) (+ c 1)
                      (if (> c start)
                          (append acc (list (subgrid grid 0 start
                                                     (- (rows grid) 1)
                                                     (- c 1))))
                          acc)))
               (else (scan (+ c 1) start acc)))))
     (define (majority vals)
       (let ((nz (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) vals)))
         (if (empty? nz)
             0
             (first (first (sort (map (lambda (col)
                                        (list col
                                              (count-if (lambda (v)
                                                          (= v col))
                                                        nz)))
                                      (remove-duplicates nz))
                                 (lambda (a b)
                                   (if (= (second a) (second b))
                                       (< (first a) (first b))
                                       (> (second a) (second b))))))))))
     (define (palette-from plain colored)  ;; depth -> majority color
       (let* ((layers (onion plain))
              (depths (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
                              (apply append layers))))
         (map (lambda (d)
                (majority (map (lambda (p) (at colored (first p)
                                              (second p)))
                               (filter (lambda (p)
                                         (= (at layers (first p)
                                                (second p))
                                            d))
                                       (grid-positions layers)))))
              (range 1 (+ (if (empty? depths) 0 (apply max depths))
                          1)))))
     (define (recolor panel palette)
       (let ((layers (onion panel)))
         (grid-from-fn (rows panel) (cols panel)
                       (lambda (r c)
                         (let ((d (at layers r c)))
                           (cond ((= d 0) 0)
                                 ((empty? palette) 0)
                                 (else (nth palette
                                            (min (- d 1)
                                                 (- (length palette)
                                                    1))))))))))
     (let* ((panels (panels-of g))
            (expected (recolor (third panels)
                               (palette-from (first panels)
                                             (second panels)))))
       (list (map (lambda (cand) (if (equal? expected cand) 8 0))
                  (rest (rest (rest panels)))))))))
